newsitem.title: USA: Carolina 767 MW Brunswick nuke in startup.
newsitem.headline: Carolina 767 MW Brunswick nuke in startup.

text.p: Carolina Power & Light Co's 767 megawatt Brunswick nuclear power unit 1 was in a restart mode early Wednesday, back from a refueling outage that began Oct 5, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Southport, N.C. unit was in "startup, holding for testing," and producing electricity at about seven percent of capacity as of early Wednesday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
The unit was shut for scheduled refueling and maintenance.
The 754 megawatt Brunswick nuclear unit 2 was operating normally at full production, the NRC said.
